intro: Dwarven craftsmen keep their furnaces and workshops working in Stormwind's northern quarter. The district brings a piece of Khaz Modan to the human capital, with the Deeprun Tram linking it to Ironforge.

sections.t: A Home Away from Khaz Modan
p: Dwarven artisans, smiths, and engineers make their home in Stormwind's northern quarter. Heavy stonework, smelting works, and craft shops recall Ironforge. At Potts' Plates, craftspeople from Khaz Modan find familiar company. On the district's eastern side, an open, arched tunnel leads to the Stormwind station of the Deeprun Tram, linking the human capital directly to Ironforge.
